message.content: so I presume we are switching to running in the cloud instead of local?

content.text:
No — nothing changed. Still local Claude Code on your Mac.

"Cloud" would mean something different:
- **Anthropic Console / API** — no filesystem access, can't run your repo
- **Claude.ai web** — chat only, no tools
- **Cowork / hosted sandbox** — runs in a remote container, but your repo isn't there

What you're running is **local CC** = Claude Code CLI on your MacBook, reading/writing files in `~/ev-auto-trader-canada` directly, executing `git`/`npm`/Chrome MCP against your machine. Terminal vs standalone app is just two front-ends to the same local process.

The overnight halt wasn't a local-vs-cloud thing — it was the harness's cwd-based permission boundary. Same boundary applies in both terminal and app, both local. Fix is just launching with the right cwd.

If you ever DO want unattended overnight execution that survives your Mac sleeping/closing, that'd be a real cloud move (remote VM running CC). Not what we're doing tonight.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# Mac-to-GitHub packaging script for ev-auto-trader-canada.
# Run from a fresh Terminal window. Do NOT paste into Claude Code.
# Requires: bash 3.2+ (Mac default is fine), git, ssh/https access to barsnbolts/ev-auto-trader-canada.

# ---------- 1. cd ----------
cd ~/ev-auto-trader-canada

# ---------- 2. verify env ----------
case "$PWD" in
  */ev-auto-trader-canada) ;;
  *) echo "FATAL: pwd=$PWD does not end in /ev-auto-trader-canada"; exit 1 ;;
esac

REMOTE_URL=$(git remote get-url origin)
case "$REMOTE_URL" in
  *barsnbolts/ev-auto-trader-canada*) ;;
  *) echo "FATAL: origin=$REMOTE_URL does not contain barsnbolts/ev-auto-trader-canada"; exit 1 ;;
esac

echo "== environment OK =="
echo "  pwd:    $PWD"
echo "  origin: $REMOTE_URL"
echo

# ---------- 3. fetch ----------
echo "== git fetch --all =="
git fetch --all
echo

# ---------- 4. checkout working branch ----------
BRANCH="claude/verify-environment-setup-oTu3S"
echo "== checkout $BRANCH =="
if git show-ref --verify --quiet "refs/heads/$BRANCH"; then
  git checkout "$BRANCH"
  if git rev-parse "@{upstream}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    git pull --ff-only
  fi
elif git show-ref --verify --quiet "refs/remotes/origin/$BRANCH"; then
  git checkout -b "$BRANCH" "origin/$BRANCH"
else
  echo "FATAL: branch $BRANCH not found locally or on origin"
  exit 1
fi
echo

# ---------- 5. mkdir handoff ----------
mkdir -p docs/handoff/superpowers

HANDOFF_FILES=()
MISSING_FILES=()

# ---------- 6. copy Mac-only files ----------
copy_if_exists() {
  local src="$1" dst="$2"
  if [ -f "$src" ]; then
    cp "$src" "$dst"
    echo "  COPIED: $src -> $dst"
    HANDOFF_FILES+=("$dst")
  else
    echo "  MISSING: $src"
    MISSING_FILES+=("$src")
  fi
}

echo "== copy plan + CLAUDE.md files =="
copy_if_exists "$HOME/.claude/plans/you-are-continuing-the-shiny-pixel.md" \
               "docs/handoff/PLAN_M0_M12_AUTHORITATIVE.md"
copy_if_exists "$HOME/.claude/CLAUDE.md" \
               "docs/handoff/CLAUDE_USER_GLOBAL.md"
copy_if_exists "$HOME/.claude/projects/-Users-ianmcadam-ev-auto-trader-canada/CLAUDE.md" \
               "docs/handoff/CLAUDE_PROJECT.md"
echo

# ---------- 7. copy Superpowers SKILL.md files ----------
SKILLS_DIR="$HOME/.claude/plugins/cache/superpowers-marketplace/superpowers/5.0.7/skills"
echo "== copy Superpowers SKILL.md files =="
if [ -d "$SKILLS_DIR" ]; then
  while IFS= read -r -d '' skill_md; do
    skill_name=$(basename "$(dirname "$skill_md")")
    dst="docs/handoff/superpowers/${skill_name}.md"
    cp "$skill_md" "$dst"
    echo "  COPIED: $skill_md -> $dst"
    HANDOFF_FILES+=("$dst")
  done < <(find "$SKILLS_DIR" -type f -name SKILL.md -print0)
else
  echo "  MISSING: $SKILLS_DIR (cache dir not found — Superpowers may not be installed)"
  MISSING_FILES+=("$SKILLS_DIR")
fi
echo

# ---------- 8. inventory pre-existing uncommitted work ----------
echo "== inventory uncommitted work =="
UNTRACKED=()
while IFS= read -r line; do
  [ -n "$line" ] && UNTRACKED+=("$line")
done < <(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)

MODIFIED=()
while IFS= read -r line; do
  [ -n "$line" ] && MODIFIED+=("$line")
done < <(git diff --name-only)

PRESTAGED=()
while IFS= read -r line; do
  [ -n "$line" ] && PRESTAGED+=("$line")
done < <(git diff --name-only --cached)

echo "  untracked (${#UNTRACKED[@]}):"
if [ ${#UNTRACKED[@]} -gt 0 ]; then for f in "${UNTRACKED[@]}"; do echo "    $f"; done; fi
echo "  modified  (${#MODIFIED[@]}):"
if [ ${#MODIFIED[@]} -gt 0 ]; then for f in "${MODIFIED[@]}"; do echo "    $f"; done; fi
echo "  prestaged (${#PRESTAGED[@]}):"
